finalMessage:
`checkRefundLimit` now throws `InvalidRefundAmountError` for a zero or negative amount. Over-limit refunds still throw `RefundTooLargeError`. The full suite passes (37/37), and `ostf check --base main` reports no diagnostics.

**Changes**
- `src/refunds.ts`: added `InvalidRefundAmountError`. `checkRefundLimit` checks `amount <= 0` first, then `amount > leftOnCharge`. The doc comment is updated to match. The daily-limit logic is unchanged.
- `src/refunds.test.ts`: the zero-amount assertion moved out of `rejects more than is left on the charge` into a new test, `rejects a refund of zero or less`, which also covers -1.
- `trace/requirements.yaml`: new draft item `R-REFUND-AMOUNT`, refining `N-REFUNDS`, with code links to `checkRefundLimit` and `InvalidRefundAmountError` and a test link to the new test. I did not edit `R-REFUND-LIMIT`'s text.

**OSTF impact (base `main`)**
- Items added: `R-REFUND-AMOUNT` (draft).
- Links added: `R-REFUND-AMOUNT refines N-REFUNDS`; the new test verifies `R-REFUND-AMOUNT`; `InvalidRefundAmountError` and `checkRefundLimit` implement `R-REFUND-AMOUNT`.
- Links stamped after recheck: `checkRefundLimit` implements and verifies `R-REFUND-LIMIT`. Both had gone suspect because the function body changed. `R-REFUND-LIMIT` is `riskRelevant: true`, so please look at these. I confirmed the code still meets the item and the tests pass before stamping.
- Tests named by the impact list: `src/refunds.test.ts#Refunder > totals refunds per account and UTC day`, `src/refunds.test.ts#checkRefundLimit`, `src/refunds.test.ts#checkRefundLimit > rejects a refund of zero or less`, and `src/refunds.test.ts#checkRefundLimit > rejects more than is left on the charge`.

I haven't committed or opened a PR. If you want one, I can do that with the item and test names above in the description.
